future_calibrated_evaluation_protocol.protocol_name: Nested K-Fold Stratified Threshold Tuning & Out-of-Fold Calibration
steps: 1. Partition training data into K inner folds (disjoint by candidate & job entities).
2. Optimize decision thresholds tau_GF and tau_PF to maximize macro F1 / utility on validation folds.
3. Freeze thresholds prior to evaluating on the independent held-out benchmark.
4. Never tune thresholds directly on the test or final validation benchmark labels.
future_calibrated_evaluation_protocol.guarantee: Eliminates optimistic threshold selection bias and yields unbiased generalization estimates.
